## Objective
Add a real venue-evidence path that separates decision, submission, acceptance, fill, rejection, and account clocks and reconciles model execution against venue-settled outcomes.

## Owning authority
- D-116 independent economic parity.
- docs/audits/D136_EPISTEMIC_ECONOMIC_OBSERVABILITY.md
- docs/issues/ISSUE_AUD008_MAKER_FILL_PROBABILITY_AND_ADVERSE_SELECTION.md
- Existing TCA contract represented by #268.

## Change class
CONTRACT_IMPLEMENTATION

## Current state
v8-next economic benchmark reports model/simulated fills only. shadow_live fields are UNRUN, no venue-settled fill ledger is consumed, and implementation shortfall including unfilled opportunity cost is not computed.

## Required end state
R1 — Ingest physically produced venue order/fill/account artifacts with source and receipt clocks.
R2 — Measure model fill versus real fill, latency drag, adverse selection, fees, and missed-fill opportunity cost.
R3 — Reconcile venue account cash, position, funding, commission, and realized/unrealized P&L without double counting.
R4 — Keep execution SIM_ONLY or EXECUTION_UNPROVEN until all required evidence exists.

## Expected file / module surface
v8-next/src/v8_next/adapters/shadow_ingest.py
v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/economic_benchmark.py
v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/parity.py
v8-next/src/v8_next/app/economic.py
v8-next/tests/test_capture_integrity.py
v8-next/tests/test_d153_parity.py
v8-next/tests/test_shortfall_reconciliation.py (new)

## Verification gates
Test event-clock ordering, partial/rejected/unfilled orders, adverse selection, fee/funding reconciliation, tamper/missing artifact blocking, and exact rerun determinism using physical fixtures only in tests. No production trade is required to test refusal paths.

## Required evidence artifacts
Venue manifest; order/fill/account ledgers; source hashes; shortfall decomposition; reconciliation receipt; explicit absent fields; model-versus-real comparison report.

## Non-goals / forbidden scope
No live-money activation, no synthetic fills in production, no inferred venue behavior from OHLC bars, no claim that a simulator is venue-correct without settled account evidence.

### Context-completeness contract

### 11. Normative Traceability
R1 — Event and receipt clocks are distinct. Authority: D-116/D136.
R2 — Unfilled opportunity cost is included only when the declared horizon and counterfactual are available.
R3 — Inseparable components remain UNRESOLVED.

### 12. Existing Types / Interfaces to Reuse
Reuse shadow ingest schemas, ArtifactBinding, ParityReceipt, SemanticMapping, native account snapshots, and existing fail-closed statuses.

### 13. Mathematical / Semantic Invariants
I1: decision <= submission <= acceptance/fill/rejection clocks.
I2: cashflow conservation closes to zero within the declared exact accounting representation.
I3: missing/unpaired venue records cannot become zero shortfall.

### 14. Canonical Failure Semantics
Missing venue artifact -> DATA_BLOCKED.
Clock inversion -> INVALID.
Unpaired account/fill -> EXECUTION_UNPROVEN.
Inseparable drag -> UNRESOLVED.
No settled evidence -> SIM_ONLY.

### 15. Dependency Map
venue capture -> artifact verification -> semantic mapping -> shortfall/TCA -> account reconciliation -> evidence verdict.

### 16. Ambiguity / OPEN_PIN Triggers
- If an owning contract or estimand is ambiguous, STOP and open an OPEN_PIN.
- If an artifact cannot be physically produced and hashed, STOP; do not substitute it.
- If the requested behavior would open protected OOS or mint authority, STOP pending explicit governance.

### References / sources / attachments
Related: #268, #357, #368. v8-next currently documents this as outstanding.

### V8 guards
- [x] I will not invent a new canonical error code, ontology, or parallel interface unless an R# requirement explicitly authorizes it.
- [x] No unrelated semantic strategy change is bundled into this implementation issue.
- [x] No frozen OOS is opened unless this issue explicitly carries that authority.
- [x] If the owning contract is ambiguous, I will open/escalate an OPEN_PIN rather than invent an interpretation.
